key_idea: N is only 1000, so build Pascal's triangle row by row modulo K and count zeros.
sketch: Keep one rolling row of C(i,j) mod K, updating in place from right to left with the recurrence, and count entries equal to 0 after each row. O(N^2) = 5e5 operations. Pitfalls: K=1 makes every entry (including C(0,0)) divisible, so initialise with 1 % K; the count needs no big numbers because only residues are stored.
